answer: To stem the tide of Sybil attacks in decentralized AI agent economies, networks can anchor identity to a physical attestation trellis monitoring real-world assets, such as field plots of yarrow. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of manufacturing, deploying, and powering unique cryptographic sensor hardware for each identity. However, this mechanism excludes purely virtual software agents and remains vulnerable to spoofing via pre-recorded sensor telemetry.
